totalJsBytes.source: Cap from the Next production build (plan Story 5.9, decision D7). Measured on the Bun 1.4.3 minified build 2026-10-21: 5,680,778 B. Relaxation of the old 5 MB size-limit gate, default pending owner confirmation.

initialJsBytes.source: Measured on the Bun 1.4.3 minified build 2026-10-21: 1,494,183 B, x 1.05. AMBER: the Next per-route first-load comparison (Task 0.4d) was never measured, so the x 1.10 cross-check is open.

largestChunkBytes.source: Measured on the Bun 1.4.3 minified build 2026-10-21: 1,494,183 B (the entry chunk), x 1.05.

maxWallMs.source: plan Story 5.5 / REQ-M1; measured about 1,100 ms warm on 2026-10-21; raised from 10000 to 30000 on 2026-10-28 after contended-host builds took 13-42 s, then to 90000 on 2026-10-29 after builds took 47-59 s at host load 130-235
